# Required check manifest for vizra-search (ADR-002 § CI fan-in and merge queue).
#
# `ci-required` reads this file and fails unless every listed job concluded
# `success`. Anything else — failure, cancellation, timeout, skip, never-ran —
# fails the aggregate, so a lane that silently stops running blocks the merge
# instead of disappearing.
#
# One job name per line. Blank lines and # comments are ignored.
# This file is owner-reviewed (CODEOWNERS): it must not be edited in the same
# PR as the code it guards.

fmt
vet
echo-containment
build
contract-drift
test
test-noskip
tidy-check
